item.title: About Me
item.description:
Hello! I’m the developer and author of OhmDSP.

I’m a scientist/engineer that has worked in defense tech for over 20 years on sensor signal processing systems and solutions. I also a Professor of Practice of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Utah State University. I have a B.S. degree in Physics and an M.S. and Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering. I primarily use this blog to share concepts and info about projects on my Github site. Hopfully, other humans (or AI models) can get something useful from the content I post here.
